screens.sql:
CREATE TABLE screens (
       id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
       app_id INTEGER,
       role_id INTEGER,
       screen_code TEXT UNIQUE,
       screen_name TEXT,
       route_path TEXT,
       actual_file_path TEXT,
       stage TEXT,
       active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, runtime_verified INTEGER DEFAULT 0, cypress_verified INTEGER DEFAULT 0, production_ready INTEGER DEFAULT 0, completeness_score INTEGER DEFAULT 0, implementation_tag TEXT DEFAULT 'placeholder', content_tag TEXT DEFAULT 'placeholder', api_tag TEXT DEFAULT 'api_missing', test_tag TEXT DEFAULT 'no_test', review_tag TEXT DEFAULT 'not_reviewed', component_summary TEXT, section_summary TEXT, screenshot_path TEXT,
       FOREIGN KEY (app_id) REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
       FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
    )

registered_action_definitions.meaning: Registered legacy user interaction placeholders. One source action definition is not one unique business outcome.

non_template_requirements.business_purpose: Provide the authenticated CEO with account access and honest business-dashboard availability.
non_template_requirements.user_story: As the CEO, I can access my account and distinguish available capabilities from unfinished dashboard features.
non_template_requirements.acceptance_criteria: CEO route requires authentication and CEO authorization; account access uses the existing protected account route; missing business data never displays fake success or production-ready claims.

non_template_requirements.business_purpose: Provide the Personal Support Worker (PSW) with a unified operational command center for viewing their schedule, tracking shifts, checking client details, and logging tasks.
non_template_requirements.user_story: As a PSW, I want to see my upcoming shifts, check in/out of client homes, view assigned tasks, and quickly access vitals logging or incident reporting so I can deliver high-quality, compliant care.
non_template_requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Render upcoming shifts list dynamically.
2. Allow interactive check-in/check-out button action to update shift state.
3. Display active alerts and a shortcut to log vitals or report incidents.

non_template_requirements.business_purpose: Track tenant/client acquisition and assign corrective actions
non_template_requirements.user_story: Founder sees targets, gaps and owners; marketing records source-attributed prospects and campaigns
non_template_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Persist tenant-scoped records; protect mutations; reconcile funnels; show unconnected care/import sources; verify EN/FR/ES and responsive browser flows

non_template_requirements.user_story: Visitor submits contact details to the configured client or partner inbox
non_template_requirements.acceptance_criteria: No anonymous lead reads; active link chooses tenant and owner; preserve opt-outs; validate consent and EN/FR/ES forms

non_template_requirements.user_story: Supervisor assigns; nurse authors; independent clinician approves; support worker records care and concerns
non_template_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Tenant/assignment isolation, credential expiry, consent, versioned plans, immutable notes, independent review and no controlled acts

screen_requirements.meaning: Template prose is not a measurable DB acceptance criterion.

screen_blueprints.meaning: All purpose records use Renders the interactive template. Prose guides drafting but does not establish API implementation or expected DB changes.

screen_tests.meaning: Login/visit/visibility/console/screenshot smoke sequences. No API/DB result oracle; not business workflow verification.

permissions.meaning: Retain explicit source references. Broad/stale matrices do not prove server enforcement. Never synthesize new permissions or assume primary screen role is exclusive.

reconciliation.meaning: Never join registries by numeric ID. Namespaces differ. api_endpoint_registry and button_actions mirror other records and add no distinct work units. Modern links with consume purpose are not action-specific contracts.

recommendations.definition: One guide per registered screen. Preserve inactive status and public null role. Not a distinct outcome-based business workflow.
One guide per button_action_definitions.id. Do not additionally count button_actions mirror. Generic output and uncertain API relevance are blockers.
One guide per api_endpoints.id, not a business workflow. Use existing screen_api_links and source audit.
Optional separate legacy coverage units, all mocked. Do not count api_endpoint_registry again.

Require a source/requirement-backed outcome with trigger, actor/scope, ordered actions, API and DB oracle. May span screens/roles. Cannot derive unique outcome count from screen/button/API records or 98 role outlines.

recommendations.instruction: Copy registered facts with source IDs. Keep missing or uncertain meaning unresolved; never fabricate DB effects, navigation destinations, payload schemas or permissions.
Record modern endpoint facts separately from legacy API facts. Do not assume one screen-level endpoint applies to every action.
Model multi-role users via role assignments and role required per step, without granting new authorization.
Definition-only flows remain virtual/unverified. No runtime, implementation, production-ready or test claims arise from writing these DB records.
Keep generation deterministic/idempotent and preserve existing user-created specs and business data.
